title: Exact Copy App Ad
tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.
exact_text.read_as: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: The first scene replaces the required period after 'scrolling' with a comma.
Calendar graphics contain extra numerals and malformed text-like markings, particularly at 5.7 seconds, violating the requirement that only the three supplied lines appear as visible text.

judge.summary: The ad follows the cream-and-green calendar-and-checkmark direction, but incorrect first-line punctuation and extra calendar text require correction.

must_haves.item: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 9 seconds and the frames are 16:9; the sampled scene order is consistent with three 3-second scenes, but exact transition times cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
must_haves.why: It reads 'Less scrolling, More doing.' with a comma instead of the first period.

must_haves.item: The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
must_haves.why: The line is legible and matches the required capitalization and punctuation.

must_haves.item: The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
must_haves.why: The line is legible and matches the required capitalization and punctuation.

must_haves.item: Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
must_haves.why: The first line has altered punctuation, and the calendar includes additional numerals and garbled character-like markings.

must_haves.item: The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
must_haves.why: Cream-and-green calendar and checkmark graphics are visible and change across the samples, but silence and continuous animation cannot be verified from still frames.
